create.name: Dustin DiPerna
create.bio:
Dustin DiPerna is a meditation teacher and writer on religion who studied world religions at Harvard and now teaches courses on meditation and finding purpose at Stanford University. For around two decades he worked closely with the philosopher Ken Wilber, and Integral Theory shapes much of his writing, especially his interest in how the major traditions can support stages of inner growth. His main meditation training came from the late Daniel P. Brown, with whom he studied for sixteen years and co-led Tibetan Mahamudra and Dzogchen retreats for a decade.

His retreats teach classical systems step by step, such as the nine stages of concentration from the Indo-Tibetan tradition, followed by the early stages of insight, with the aim that students leave with a practice they can keep up at home. He teaches in the United States, Europe, Australia and China, and records short talks for Insight Timer. His books include Streams of Wisdom, a guide to spiritual development, Evolution's Ally, on religious traditions as paths of transformation, and Earth is Eden, written with Jon Darrall-Rew. He lives in California with his family.

books.title: Streams of Wisdom: An Advanced Guide to Spiritual Development
books.author: Dustin DiPerna
books.description: Maps the ways a person can grow spiritually, distinguishing states of meditative experience from stages of development, and draws on several religious traditions to show how they fit together. Written from an Integral point of view.

books.title: Evolution's Ally: Our World's Religious Traditions as Conveyor Belts of Transformation
books.author: Dustin DiPerna
books.description: Argues that the great religions can do more than preserve belief and can actively help people mature. Looks at how traditions might be redesigned to support each stage of inner growth.

books.title: Earth is Eden: An Integral Exploration of the Trans-Himalayan Teachings
books.author: Jon Darrall-Rew, Dustin DiPerna
books.description: Co-written with Jon Darrall-Rew, this book reads the esoteric Trans-Himalayan teachings through Integral Theory. It considers what those writings say about the purpose of human life and spiritual service.

courses.title: Stages of Tranquility and Insight
courses.description: A weekend meditation retreat at Esalen teaching the classical nine-stage path of concentration, known as the Elephant Path, with physical sensation as the anchor for attention. It ends with an introduction to the first stages of insight practice. Open to beginners.

free_resources.title: Beyond Mindfulness: With Dustin DiPerna
free_resources.description: An eleven-minute talk on Insight Timer about what lies past basic mindfulness training in the contemplative traditions. Free to play in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: The Treasury Of Wisdom
free_resources.description: A ten-minute talk on Insight Timer about the shared inheritance of the world's wisdom traditions and how to draw on it. Free to play.
